title: Creating edited defaults
text:
Of course, edited default for me is not just actually getting the image but it may also mean like getting different colors. I used the search function for this and tried to find a tutorial to make edited defaults and I found none. If you find one please let me know.

1. How to make different Colors in a regular Defaults Avatar

Anyways, as you know happycupcake created a random default AoPS avatar generator. You can copy and paste this link: externalfile:dmboannefpncccogfdikhmhpmdnddgoe%3A~%252FMyFiles%252FDownloads%252Favatargenerator%20(1)%252Ezip%3A7c76a1cf61f7f564677318e6d9c869ad6bd61307/avatargenerator.html and find it.

You can also go to the Avatar Depot to get some of the regular default avatars.

Anyways, choose a regular Default Avatar(CHOOSE BY SHAPE NOT COLOR!) and drag the avatar into a new tab. Now copy the URL of the image. For example, I chose this from EulerNumber. https://cdn.artofproblemsolving.com/attachments/b/6/389161687399c2db9dabe9e057d1a12ec11b2e.png.

I personally like to go to www.lunapic.com for coloring in the AoPS avatars. Once you go there, you will see a place to put your URL. Please copy and paste your link there.

Then it will take you to a place that looks like every other photo editor. We go to the left and try to find a bucket. (see that?). Click that. Then it will load. Change your color by clicking on the cyan colored thing. Choose your color an then click "choose". Next, click a square that you want to be painted by the color you chose. See that? Although it might take forever, it will become colorful. My AoPS avatar went from the original avatar to this image: https://www4.lunapic.com/editor/working/159371658492658745?5588083500.
